scope: Retained AF_UNIX sendmmsg on stream/datagram/seqpacket endpoints and paired packet scalar/vector/sendto/recvfrom I/O on workers, including progress across original-owner/task handoff.
method: Four independent processes, each 1,000 checked iterations, four Trames vCPUs and three unprofiled counterbalanced before/after samples. Final compilation, affected local Linux CI and FFI acceptance finish before timing. Identical static ARM64 musl ELF for Trames/native Linux; Linux uses the existing six-vCPU ARM64 environment and is stopped before Mac timing. Batch iterations send eight checked one-byte datagrams with sendmmsg and receive each packet; native macOS explicitly uses eight POSIX sendmsg calls, not a claimed native batch API. Paired scalar/vector cases send and receive two checked bytes in one packet. Endpoint setup/cleanup is outside loop timing. Prior addressed-datagram and socketpair workloads are regression controls. Longest-child loop medians and process wall medians include different work and are recorded separately. Different APIs, kernels, compilers and CPU counts make native timings contextual; these are not whole-app/Firefox/physical-iPad or generally native-speed claims.

unchanged_vfs.reason: No trames-vfs source changes in this runtime commit

resource_regressions: stream/datagram/seqpacket messages retain exact msg_len and packet boundaries
lazy later fault returns completed count; post-send msg_len EFAULT cannot undo delivery
zero/compat flags/1,024 cap, short stream send and partial EAGAIN preserve original results
waiting first item freezes its input and old target across FD close/reuse and pathname rebind; next unaccepted item resolves independently
a different later dispatcher factory cannot replace the accepted original descriptor/credential domain
legacy rights handoff after earlier success resumes at the original next item and original full OFD
partial EPIPE carries terminal positive count and task signal without replaying prior messages
validation.unchanged_acceptance: Unchanged VFS, CPU/memory/graphics acceptance and guest artifacts reused. No repeated full acceptance for documentation or pin-only edits.

implementation.progress: Per-accepted-call state only: completed count, active prepared item, canonical target and terminal task effect. The mutex does not serialize unrelated guest calls; queue/Files locks remain their original object-local mechanisms.
implementation.message_import: Original requested/sendmsg ABI, lazy later header import and accepted original Files/credentials. Only active portable input/rights are frozen; a still-unaccepted owner-only rights item retains its original owner decoder boundary.
implementation.waits: Subscribe/retry on the original source and active target, first-item waits return execution slots. After prior success EAGAIN returns the completed count.
implementation.signal: Partial EPIPE records the terminal count and hands task effects to the original owner, without packet replay or another filter decision.
implementation.single_message: Keep single-message records inline in their existing Arc allocation; batch state alone uses separate allocation. Existing immediate paired message and stream paths preserved.

remaining: Native TCP/UDP batches and owner-only ancillary/resource effects
recvmmsg is currently unimplemented, not a remaining implemented coordinator path
Unix-bearing owning graphs, device opens/rights and native-service adapters
Legacy PTY/task/job-control and pending task signal paths
io_uring controls, mount/nsfs topology and proc controls
